decision: when to store or dispatch solar power ahead of cloud cover
baseline_practice: fixed schedules and manual weather checks
mechanism: better solar output forecasts let operators hold dispatch until the sun returns
failure_modes: forecasts unused if dispatch is already locked in; the marginal grid may still burn fossil fuel

decision: where to pre-position crews and stage power shutoffs
baseline_practice: historical burn maps and manual inspections
mechanism: earlier, higher-resolution risk scores focus suppression on the highest-risk areas
actors: utility wildfire teams and fire agencies
failure_modes: false alarms trigger unneeded shutoffs; models miss dry-wind events

decision: which forest parcels to inspect and enforce
mechanism: satellite alerts flag newly cleared areas sooner
failure_modes: alerts not acted on; clearing shifts to unmonitored areas (leakage)

decision: which posts to label or downrank
mechanism: classify coordinated false claims so platforms can reduce their reach
failure_modes: weak evidence that reach reductions change beliefs; adversarial evasion

decision: where to drill and how to route logistics
mechanism: better subsurface models and logistics raise output per dollar
failure_modes: lower cost expands extraction; emissions rise despite the efficiency gain

decision: which products or ads to personalize
mechanism: personalization raises conversion and purchase frequency
failure_modes: more efficient selling grows total consumption
